thread:
Priya: quick follow-up from the streaming postmortem — we need explicit owners, short timelines, and a simple verification plan. postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/streaming-196349 (summary attached in doc)

Tom: thanks. i can take the reconnect + client handshake improvements. proposal: bump client handshake timeout to 3s, add capped exponential backoff with full jitter. prototype in 6 days, canary 2w.

Luis: i'll take the server-side chunking/serialization bug. observed truncation when outbound chunk boundary aligns with kv eviction. i'll add a repro harness and a unit test that simulates eviction during streaming.

Greta: i'll own observability + alerting. need per-request partial flags and a histogram of chunk-counts per response. ETA: 3 days to land metrics, then dashboard + PD rule in 10 days.

Priya: good. also need a short runbook for forcing LB fallback and for disabling new client push in case of regressions. who can write that?

Tom: i can draft runbook steps for client rollback and feature-flag kill switch. will include curl snippets and the admin toggle path.

Luis: actionables i've captured so far:
- RM-01: Add synthetic per-region streaming test that runs every hour and reports partial-response rate 1% threshold alert 1 owner: Greta 1 due: 2026-03-29
- RM-02: Reproduce truncated chunk bug and add unit+integration tests to CI 1 owner: Luis 1 due: 2026-03-26
- RM-03: Implement server-side safe-chunking (deferred flush when KV eviction pending) 1 owner: Luis 1 due: 2026-04-06
- RM-04: Client handshake clamp and capped jitter backoff w/ metrics (reconnect_count, last_reason) 1 owner: Tom 1 due: 2026-04-02
- RM-05: Per-request telemetry: tag partials, timeouts, and LB-shed hits; surface by route/model 1 owner: Greta 1 due: 2026-03-31
- RM-06: Canary plan + automatic rollback criteria (partial increase >20% or p99 latency +30%) 1 owner: Priya & infra 1 due: 2026-04-12

Greta: small note on RM-01: synthetic stream should be light-weight (200 tokens, single model) and originate from 4 regions. i'll add a low-cost lambda variant for regions with strict cost constraints.

Tom: for RM-04 i'll also add a client-side flag to emit reconnect telemetry to a separate telemetry topic to avoid spamming default logs.

Priya: rollback criteria are important. infra-bot: please create an infra ticket for coordinating LB rollback and canary smoke checks.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-712, assigned to Greta and infra-oncall. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-712

Luis: risk notes: changing chunk flush timing could increase tail latency for a small subset of long streams. we'll measure p50/p95/p99 during canary and have an immediate rollback path.

Greta: alert proposal: page P1 if partial-response ratio > 0.2% for 10m OR if synthetic stream fails > 3 consecutive runs. also add a weekly digest to #eng-runtime that highlights model warmups correlated with partial spikes.

Tom: schedule: weekly sync Wed 08:00 PST for remediation check-ins, plus ad-hoc sync after each canary day. ops-bot: please schedule.

ops-bot: scheduled "Streaming remediation weekly" every Wed 08:00 PST starting 2026-03-25 and created calendar event. link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/events/streaming-remediation

Priya: owners recap: Greta (observability + synthetic tests + alerts), Luis (chunking + tests), Tom (client reconnect + runbook), Priya & infra (canary + rollback). next check-in: 2026-03-27 16:00 UTC. please update RM tickets with progress before the meeting.

Luis: i'll open PRs with the repro harness and initial unit tests today. will tag reviewers.

Greta: i'll push the metrics change behind a feature flag and start feeding the dashboard once enabled in staging.

Tom: i'll write the client design doc and attach the rollback playbook. will include sample backoff code snippet: `backoff = min(base * 2**attempt, max) * random()`.

Priya: thanks all. if you hit blockers post here or DM me. closing this follow-up thread and moving items to remediation board: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1963502711. :white_check_mark:
